conditions.name: Common Cold
precautions: Stay hydrated with warm fluids
Get adequate rest
Use steam inhalation for congestion
Avoid cold beverages and exposure
Consult a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 7-10 days

conditions.name: Influenza
precautions: Rest as much as possible
Drink plenty of fluids
Monitor temperature regularly
Isolate from others to prevent spread
Seek medical care if breathing becomes difficult

conditions.name: COVID-19
precautions: Isolate to prevent spreading infection
Monitor oxygen levels if possible
Stay hydrated and rest
Wear a mask around others
Seek urgent care if breathing difficulty develops

conditions.name: Migraine
precautions: Rest in a quiet, dark room
Stay hydrated
Avoid known triggers such as bright light or strong smells
Apply a cold compress to the forehead
Consult a doctor if migraines are frequent or severe

conditions.name: Food Poisoning
precautions: Stay hydrated with oral rehydration solutions
Eat light, bland food once tolerated
Avoid dairy and oily food temporarily
Rest and monitor symptoms
Seek medical care if vomiting/diarrhea persists over 24 hours or blood appears

conditions.name: Gastritis
precautions: Avoid spicy and oily food
Eat smaller, more frequent meals
Avoid alcohol and NSAIDs
Stay hydrated
Consult a doctor if pain is persistent or severe

conditions.name: Dengue
precautions: Stay hydrated and monitor for warning signs
Avoid NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin
Use paracetamol only as directed by a physician
Watch for bleeding, severe abdominal pain, or persistent vomiting
Seek immediate medical attention for worsening symptoms

conditions.name: Malaria
precautions: Seek prompt medical testing and treatment
Stay hydrated
Rest and monitor temperature closely
Use mosquito protection to avoid further exposure
Do not self-medicate with antimalarials

conditions.name: Typhoid
precautions: Seek medical diagnosis and appropriate antibiotic treatment
Stay hydrated with clean, safe water
Eat easily digestible food
Rest adequately
Practice good hygiene to prevent spread

conditions.name: Allergic Reaction
precautions: Avoid the suspected allergen or trigger
Use an antihistamine if previously advised by a doctor
Apply a cool compress to affected skin
Monitor for worsening swelling or breathing difficulty
Seek emergency care if swelling spreads to the face or throat

conditions.name: Contact Dermatitis
precautions: Avoid the irritant or allergen source
Keep the affected area clean and dry
Apply a soothing, fragrance-free moisturizer
Avoid scratching the area
Consult a doctor if the rash spreads or blisters

conditions.name: Conjunctivitis
precautions: Avoid touching or rubbing the eyes
Wash hands frequently
Use a clean, cool compress on the eyes
Avoid sharing towels or pillows
Consult a doctor if vision is affected or pain worsens

conditions.name: Fungal Skin Infection
precautions: Keep the affected area clean and dry
Avoid tight or damp clothing over the area
Avoid sharing clothing or towels
Use an over-the-counter antifungal cream if appropriate
Consult a doctor if the infection spreads or does not improve
